275596381.description: This vintage Cross desk pen set features a Brazilian green onyx base with natural color variations. It includes a gold-tone ballpoint pen displayed upright in a swivel holder mounted on the onyx base. The set comes in its original brown Cross branded box and includes the guarantee, operating instructions, and a template for centering a nameplate. The pen set appears unused and well-preserved with minimal signs of wear. All original packaging and paperwork are included, suitable for collectors or as a classic executive gift.
